featured_reviews.name: ABDUL SALAM KHAN
featured_reviews.review_text:
‎I am very happy to be a member here.
‎The atmosphere here is very good.
‎I went in at 7 pm, super friendly and helpful employees. The dressing rooms and toilets were clean. I found the pool inviting and just below my body temp, so totally comfortable. I am 35 and usually fit, but am dealing with an old injury, so was apprehensive of an unknown facility. Loved the design of the pools, which offer safe, relaxed swimming/floating. This is not a glossy fitness center, but an old, established and well-used community spot.🥰🥰🥰🥰🥰🥰
‎

featured_reviews.name: Shivangi Kumbhar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Had a really beautiful experience at Float House during our aqua relaxation practice session.

The space was nice and welcoming. The pool was clean. The time and charges were economical and so it allowed us to practice and receive with ease and presence.

A heartfelt thank you to Natasha, Mrinal, and Neeket for being such warm and gracious hosts. The care with which they manage the space truly reflects. They were kind, supportive, accommodating, and made us feel completely at ease throughout.

It feels wonderful to discover spaces in Mumbai that are open to healing, restorative, and mindful aquatic practices. Looking forward to coming back again for more floating, learning, and relaxation.

featured_reviews.name: Ravneet Nagpal
featured_reviews.review_text: Excellent facility for aquatic fitness and swimming. The pool is exceptionally clean, which makes for a much more pleasant swimming experience. It’s an ideal environment for both lap swimming and low-impact aqua exercises. Highly recommended for the hygiene standards.

featured_reviews.name: Sanket Valimbe
featured_reviews.review_text:
I booked it for my son's Birthday party.
Swimming pool experience was good, though it was humid inside the shade but kids enjoyed. It's on the costly side 18000 for 2 hours with 25 kids. Kids enjoyed in swimming, rain dance and under fountain.
Now coming to food. I paid 650/pax for 1 welcome drink, 2 starters, 2 main course items and Icre cream as dessert, along with a AC hall. It seems to be lucrative right.
Now comes the magic. Food vendor was greedy and wanna to make profit by hook or crook. Kids were asking for starters but they were deliberately delaying on bringing food from kitchen. "Khilaane ki ichha nahi thi paisaa lene k baad bhi." Food experience was horrible, pathetic etc....
I had a solid argument with mgmt and irony is after all this the lady on other side was asking me a tip for the staff members !! Full ON bakwaassss..
A BIG NO FOR FOOD, BUT YOU CAN THINK FOR SWIMMING ONCE.

featured_reviews.name: Juby Arora
featured_reviews.review_text: I enrolled my kid for the summer camp here, the experience is good. The pool is 4.5 ft and clean. All the amenities are well managed. The team on the reception are hardworking and polite. The coaching sir teaches well and skillful , and manages d kids well . The overall experience ws very gud vid float house.

featured_reviews.name: parnika patel
featured_reviews.review_text: Birthday Party Celebration at The Float House was truly pleasing. Just the right pool temperature, delicious food and an excellent service kept the guests happy. Kids enjoyed the pool to their best. The staff members, Arlene, Natasha and Snehal were hands-on to ensure all arrangements fell in place. We built cherishing memories not only for a day but, years to come at this one of a kind pool party venue. A must experience party place. Don't miss! A big thank you to Dr. Nikita and Dr. Shruti for bringing this wave of happiness to Mulundkars!!! Cheers!!! Great Going You Two!!! 👌🏼👌🏼👍🏼👍🏼

featured_reviews.name: Baid khandelwal
featured_reviews.review_text:
The pool remains shit on most weekends
So plan accordingly

The pool is clean
The coaches are excellent. They put in real efforts from heart understanding your weakness and rectify your swimming skills.
I do not like water much but wanted to learn swimming from scratch. It's been 10 sessions and now I can swim..
They have techniques and resources to teach you swimming.
The pool is temperature controlled and perfect for every age group..right from toddler to senior citizens.
They also organise parties.

featured_reviews.name: rohit terse
featured_reviews.review_text: Good place for swimming coaching, especially for kids and beginners. The water is temperature-controlled and clean. Mrunali from Staff was very helpful, and the washrooms are hygienic. Coaches are good .Overall, a well-maintained facility.

featured_reviews.review_text: The swimming pool is maintained by BMC itself and also its situated in a quite good place.let me share my review through some pros and cons.                                                              Pros: 1.Quiet good place for learners.                    2.Also high diving heights are available.                3.Water is clean nd good.                                         4.There is a bus stop just outside the complex(easy mode for BEST travellers).               Cons: 1.There is no monthly membership or any guest entry for pool.                                           2.The cost for the yearly membership is a bit high adding lockers and travelling charges.                                                    3.There is no any availability of professional instructor to learn for competitions.                 Here i m sharing some of the latest images of the admission instructions and pool.

featured_reviews.name: Sushil Dhuri
featured_reviews.review_text:
Good clean Olympic size swimming pool at Mumbai Suburban mulund west managed by BMC.
Admission can be taken by online form filling and paying fees for quarterly and yearly basis. nice waiting area for accompanied people.  There are sufficient Coach teachers available. Every batch is 45 min.  Monday is off for maintenance and on Sunday open for only swimmers.  There is also two batches per day specially for ladies.

featured_reviews.name: Jyoti Ashwin
featured_reviews.review_text: Typical BMC attitude is all I can say...how much ever one wants to avoid generalization people like these give a bad name to BMC. I had a sprained leg and requested to be allowed to sit as i couldn't climb the big steps. However, rude as they are, they constantly harassed me to go out and sit in the office...i told them the purpose of sitting here was in case of a mishap i can cater to my child but the request went on deaf ears...i obliged and went out...once out who cares...these same people didn't have the decency to give first aid to my child when he was hurt while swimming....a complaint letter of which will be documented.

featured_reviews.name: Ritesh Rahate
featured_reviews.review_text:
Kalidas Sport Complex has existed for more than 40 years now. My memory of pool when I was 10 and now are not much different. I wish they can compartmentalize proper swimming sections and have a much more robust and organised swimming courses.
I love this pool. I just wish they should refurbish and make it a world class pool.
One good thing is Ticket system has stopped and so crowd is much more controlled and filtered to those who are really interested.

featured_reviews.name: AVNI MARU
featured_reviews.review_text:
The people who sit at the reception are completely rude and total cheaters (extremely bad attitude). While taking admission, they mentioned that swimming is allowed for all 6 days except Monday.. they didn't mention that this is only for swimmers. For learners the pool is actually available only from Tuesday to Saturdays. And later after the admission was done, they mentioned that Sundays is only for swimmers. They were very rude, extremely non cooperative . Hope this review reaches the higher authorities so they know what's happening at the reception. The behaviours of their staff is completely unreasonable.

Also to add, the trainers are useless, they just sit by the side doing nothing. Overall a very bad experience. Unfortunately I took the admission for a year so will have to bear all this :(

featured_reviews.review_text:
Swimming pool needs immediate maintenance, same with changing room. Changing room/hall keeps stinking and leaking during rainy season. Half the showers are not working. Exhaust fan is not working.
Swimming costume should be made compulsory for entering in pool.
pool closed for 3 years from 23/Dec/2024 for maintenance/ renovation purpose.

featured_reviews.name: Shrikrishna Rasam
featured_reviews.review_text: Good swimming pool for self learners. Trainers are use less and will not pay attention to someone until you bribe them few bucks. Your fees includes training fees but as usual municipal behaviour shown here.

featured_reviews.name: Harsh Deokar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Best swimming 🏊‍♂️ pool with best safety.
There are two pools-

1) Long pool (It has a slope, that is it get deeper as we move from one end to other) Its  for beginners to learn swimming.
2) Deep pool (It is a deep pool approximately 13ft deep) it is for diving and for swimmers not for beginners.

There are guides who keep eye on everyone for safety. The crowd there are pretty average. Staff is good but not polite except for few. Some times the water gets dirty but its average, not like you will get ill or something.

featured_reviews.name: Anoop Quadros
featured_reviews.review_text: The only saving grace for swimming in Mulund after Kalidas pool has shut down. The pool is clean and tidy. Lifeguard available. Good management. Pool is comparatively smaller but still workable.

featured_reviews.name: Siddhesh Raorane
featured_reviews.review_text: The swimming coaching provided to my son has been excellent. The coach explains techniques clearly and ensures each child learns at their own pace. There has been a noticeable improvement in my son’s swimming skills, stamina, and confidence.

featured_reviews.review_text:
I think this is the only swimming pool option available in Mulund East. It is in Neelam nagar phase 2. It's a decent size swimming pool wherein they have trainers & they provide coaching generally to all the age groups. They have a changing & shower sections for Men & women separately.
They have various plans available to choose from. It is generally open for a limited time in morning & evening.

featured_reviews.name: Vaibhav Ambashikar
featured_reviews.review_text: A well-maintained swimming pool in a convenient location. The pool is clean, staff are friendly and helpful, and facilities like changing rooms and showers are available. Timings are 6–10 AM and 4–8 PM, and the pool remains closed on Mondays for maintenance. Great option for regular swimmers in the area.

featured_reviews.name: Nitish Pillai
featured_reviews.review_text:
Neelam Nagar Swimming Pool is a great place for swimmers of all levels, whether you're a beginner or looking to refine your technique. The coaching staff here is excellent—knowledgeable, patient, and always willing to provide tips to improve your strokes. They pay attention to individual progress, making it an ideal spot for both casual swimmers and those training seriously.

The pool is 25 meters long, well-maintained, and operates with convenient timings: mornings from 6 AM to 10 AM and evenings from 4 PM to 8 PM. These slots work well for early risers as well as those who prefer swimming after work or school.

One thing to note is that during vacations, the pool tends to get quite crowded as many kids join for swimming lessons. Additionally, with Kalidas Swimming Pool currently closed for renovation, the demand here has significantly increased. Despite the rush, the staff is helpful and ensures a smooth experience for everyone.

Overall, if you're looking for a pool with great coaching and a supportive environment, Neelam Nagar Swimming Pool is a fantastic choice!

featured_reviews.name: Farhan Shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text:
SUMA in Thane is the perfect place if you are searching for the best Indian Arabic restaurant near me. The ambience is modern, premium and ideal for family dinners, date nights or group outings. The staff is courteous and quick, and the entire experience feels refined from the moment you step in.

If you love Indian and Middle Eastern flavours, this restaurant should be on top of your list. The fiery Murgh Thecha, Dal Moradabadi Chaat, Shish Taouk, Lasooni Jheenga and the Suma Mughlai Butter Chicken are absolute must-tries. The Chicken Kabsa Rice brings authentic Middle Eastern aroma. For drinks, their mocktails are refreshing and the cocktails are priced well and crafted beautifully.

SUMA is also known for its DJ nights and Qawwali nights on alternate weekends, making it one of the best dinner places in Thane for celebrations. Whether you are searching for top restaurants in Thane, best fine dine restaurants, or Indian Arabic food in Mumbai, SUMA is a place you will recommend to others.

featured_reviews.review_text: Good facility for mid size conference and exhibitions. Excellent food Banquet sales and support team is very cooperative.

featured_reviews.name: Lakshmi Ramsubrmaniam
featured_reviews.review_text:
We celebrated mother's 90th Birthday on June 1st , and had gone 3 times to discuss and confirm everything with South Stories Restaurant manager Shiva .. who assured us a very good service and food.
We were 45 of us and we didn't bargain even for a ruppee. Whatever he had quoted we agreed but only asked for the best.
As many were Super Senior 80+ we planned it around 6.30/ 7 pm Cake Cutting for my Mom
Just then by 6 pm the Electricity in only THE THANE CLUB went off.
Why I say only The Club is because I have visited this place at the same time within a matter of 10 days for an exhibition also In the Banquet hall. The same time it was and the electricity went off.
So again on June 1st it wasnt there and whatever little decoration and other arrangements we wanted to do... Went for a flop. Moreover NO GENERATOR OR INVERTER and EMERGENCY lights in any of the rooms . So our guests had to wait in their own vehicles till the lights came .
Once the cake cutting was over and even though the MENU WAS PRE DECIDED AND FIXED... Unbelievably slow and confused service.
Guests had to wait for their food on the tables with just Chutney and Sambar.served.
The Waiters are useless and chaos in the kitchen about what to bring when.
I would never ever think of doing any function for sure here.
Shiva also was helpless just running around and sweating
Oh Yes and the ACs in this Restaurant are all maybe age old and not functioning
4 or 5 AC are there but maybe just 2 was working and cooling

Worst experience and after having complaint also by what's app and email no reply as they have got their share of money so why should they call and help or say sorry or even not to expect compensate

Hence a warning for anyone who wants to hold anything there at the Thane CLUB

featured_reviews.review_text: I was referred to Dr. Purvi for Occupational therapy for my son. Dr. Purvi understood his challenges and sensory needs and worked on the same effectively. We live overseas and I have been taking my son back to her clinic whenever we visit Mumbai since the last couple of years. The reception staff is also very proactive and helpful. I would highly recommend Dr. Purvi and her clinic for your child’s therapy needs.

featured_reviews.name: V joshi
featured_reviews.review_text:
I was referred to Aqua centre for my special needs daughter's physiotherapy. My first impressions were - quite neat, well maintained, compact centre with a polite receptionist, competitive charges, ready to accommodate our request for preferred time slots, headed by an assertive but polite pediatric physiotherapist, dedicated to her work with a command on her subject and a no nonsense attitude.
We have been with Dr Purvi for 8 months and I have seen my child gain, under Dr Purvi's expert care and guidance, both, physical skills and self-confidence. I have noticed improvent in her balance and coordination, speed of walking and running, strength and endurance. She was taught to jump and cycle by Dr Purvi - today she enjoys riding her cycle in our society premises. Her gait improved. Her response time for tasks/commands/questions has reduced. Dr Purvi takes a genuine and personal interest in each kid and creates a customised program unique to their needs. She not just helped  my child to achieve some of her developmental milestones but also helped and guided me by regularly motivating me, providing emotional support, giving me home program  to build on the therapy conducted at the centre, gave behavioural correction advice, provided contacts of schools, educators and other specialists whenever I requested her. She went out of her way to help us as a family. I could share my smallest concerns about my daughter with her and she always had some useful advice to help with them. The therapy provided to my daughter at Aqua centre was very well rounded ( mix of physiotherapy, occupational therapy, some vision activities, sensory integration and aqua therapy) Aqua therapy, in which Dr Purvi is an expert and very well trained was the most fun for my daughter (very well maintained temperature controlled pool, great care taken for safety of each child).
I highly recommend Aqua Therapy Centre for all kinds of physical therapy and Aqua Therapy. Their genuine desire to help each family that approaches them reflects in the hard work they put during each session and kids who continue to visit the centre for years.They do not work with a commercial mindset. Therapy charges are very reasonable. (I have been witness to many families who cannot afford expensive therapy, get help at this centre). I Congratulate Dr Purvi and her team for the many families they have helped and wish them all the success in future!

featured_reviews.name: Chaitanya K
featured_reviews.review_text: This swimming pool operates on a lottery-based admission system, making initial entry a matter of luck. Learners face further limitations as the pool is closed for lessons on Sundays and holidays. Despite the pool's large size, the designated learning area is disproportionately small and often overcrowded, leading to ineffective instruction. Many learners report self-teaching due to the high tutor-to-student ratio. Sometimes cleanliness can be an issue.

featured_reviews.review_text:
A decent sized swimming pool operated by thane municipality. Pool is neat and clean with well maintained changing rooms and showers.
Recommended for regular swimmers. Gets overcrowded at times and you have to find a lane for self. The timings are well suited for students and working people.

featured_reviews.name: A Bhuttar
featured_reviews.review_text:
It’s well located and a nice pool. But most of the showers in the ladies section is non functional so you just have to wait …n wait .
Also the chlorine content is so high, leading to eyes redness n itching, n discolorization of skin,  wonder if scientific measurements r used to chorinate the water or just added by the attendant “andaaza.” Need to provide flat boards , in addition to floats.
However, the lady on the cash counter is polite n very helpful so also a few of the staff that i hv interacted with.
If the doables are taken care of , it would be a great pool.If done , i will come back and update my review .
